task.title: Partition extension selections by validated kind
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/613 by projecting mixed immutable enablement intent toward separate tool, skill, and workflow lifecycle layers.
acceptance_criteria: Project one existing selection by a caller-supplied validated ExtensionKind.
Preserve exact-ID order, lookup, length, and emptiness while borrowing the same registry records.
Return an empty selection when the requested kind is absent.
Perform no filesystem access, entrypoint loading, activation, authorization, or persistence.

attempts.summary: Established RED coverage for kind-based selection projection.
attempts.diagnostic: ExtensionSelection exposed mixed records but had no operation for routing them by validated tool, skill, or workflow kind.
attempts.patch: Added focused tests requiring mixed-kind filtering, exact-ID order and lookup, wrong-kind absence, and empty projections.

attempts.diagnostic: Filtering the existing sorted borrowed vector preserves every selection accessor contract without cloning discovered records.
attempts.patch: Added ExtensionSelection::of_kind and documented its routing-intent boundary.

attempts.summary: Refactored to reuse the existing selection abstraction.
attempts.diagnostic: A second kind-view type would duplicate lookup, enumeration, length, and emptiness behavior without adding a stronger invariant.
attempts.patch: Returned ExtensionSelection directly and expanded mixed and empty projection coverage.

outcome.summary: Vela can now partition immutable selected extension metadata by validated capability kind while preserving borrowed deterministic behavior and unchanged activation boundaries.

verification.command: RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --locked in the pinned Nix environment
GitHub Rust quality gate https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/actions/runs/30188153063 and substantive exact-head CodeRabbit review at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/614

lessons: Shared installed metadata can be routed toward separate capability lifecycles without activating it.
Filtering an already sorted immutable selection naturally preserves deterministic exact-ID order.
Reusing a proven selection abstraction is preferable when a new wrapper would add no invariant.
Projection silently omits other kinds, so stricter caller intent needs a separate fail-closed operation.
